cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Why I missed our anniversary dinner belongs in the calendar review. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're having the replacement dinner now. Explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. This booking covers dinner, not the review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll cancel dessert and we can talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need to resolve the cancellation before opening a second complaint.
